POWER MECHANICS — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Evolution of motor vehicles, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Evolution of motor vehicles.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Evolution of motor vehicles.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Evolution of motor vehicles.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Evolution of motor vehicles.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

4. When learning Vehicle body joining processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle body joining processes.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Vehicle body joining processes.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Vehicle body joining processes.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Vehicle body joining processes.

5. When learning Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.

   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.

6. When learning Road wheels, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Road wheels.

7. When learning General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   D. Skip safety briefings for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.

8. When learning Vehicle body, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle body.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Vehicle body.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Vehicle body.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Vehicle body.

9. When learning Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.

10. When learning Blending of lines and curves, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Blending of lines and curves.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending of lines and curves.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Blending of lines and curves.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Blending of lines and curves.

11. When learning General workshop rules and regulations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after General workshop rules and regulations.
   B. Skip safety briefings for General workshop rules and regulations.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for General workshop rules and regulations.

12. When learning Motor Vehicle Chassis, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Motor Vehicle Chassis.

13. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Information and Communication Technology

14. When learning Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Power Mechanics workshop layout.

   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Power Mechanics workshop layout.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Power Mechanics workshop layout.

16. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Work alone with eyes closed
